notes: The image's breadboard rows j-f (upper half) are mapped to bank 'b' and rows e-a (lower half) to bank 't', matching the catalogue's row-letter naming; columns are counted from the image labels.
Bottom power rails: the upper line (black, -) is 'bn' and the lower line (red, +) is 'bp'. Rail hole numbers are estimated from the image.

Pushbutton: side 1 (1.l/1.r) is the left column pair (column 4) and side 2 (2.l/2.r) is the right column pair (column 6), straddling the centre gap. Column 4 goes to 5V and column 6 to pin 2 and the resistor, which matches the schematic.
The pull-down resistor (10 kΩ, value=10000) shares column 6 with pin 2 on the same side of the button, and goes through a short black wire (column 9) to the ground rail.
The orange wire links button column 4 to the 5V rail, and the Arduino 5V and GND header sockets feed the two rails with red and black wires.
The USB cable and the sketch code (Serial.begin(9600), pinMode, digitalRead) are not part of the build graph.
